title: Oracle’s Decline and the Future Collapse of the Ellison Empire?
author: Eric Draitser
content:
[![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/08/Theoraclearena-680x474.jpg)](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/08/11/oracles-
decline-and-the-future-collapse-of-the-ellison-empire/)

Nat Wilson Turner joins Eric Draitser to discuss the recent collapse of
Oracle's stock price and the broader implications for Larry and David Ellison,
two key figures in the sociopolitical and economic power structure of the US.
What does this mean for AI investors? What does it mean for the Paramount-
Warner Brothers-Discovery deal? How does this impact CBS News, Paramount, and
many other media properties? Nat Wilson Turner helps us sort it out.

The post [Oracle's Decline and the Future Collapse of the Ellison
Empire?](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/08/11/oracles-decline-and-the-
future-collapse-of-the-ellison-empire/) appeared first on
[CounterPunch.org](https://www.counterpunch.org).
